g.text: J5 No AI key, or the AI step fails
[no AI key is set (hasAiCredentials is false), or useAi is false]
[the call fails or is late, the JSON is wrong, or code rejects the answer]
Not in the file: "not sure", a call back within
2 working hours and a needs human ticket (P3);
no price from a neighbouring service.
